context: Tests whether the TDD skill follows strict RED-GREEN-REFACTOR discipline: tests planned and written before code, each test fails before implementation, minimal code to pass, and refactoring only when green.

checklist.name: Tests before code
checklist.description: [TEST] comments are planned before any production code is written

checklist.name: Red phase observed
checklist.description: Each test is run and fails (red) before implementation code is written to make it pass

checklist.name: Minimal green code
checklist.description: Only minimal code is written to make each failing test pass — no speculative additions

checklist.name: Refactor when green
checklist.description: Refactoring happens only after tests are green, with tests run again after each refactoring

checklist.name: Tests every change
checklist.description: Test suite is executed after every code change throughout the session
